lines.text: Before a model can read your words, it cuts them into pieces, called tokens.
Each token becomes a point in a vast space of meaning, where related words live close together.
Then every word looks at every other word, and decides what matters. This is called attention.
Layer after layer, the picture sharpens. Not just an ocean, but the ocean, at night.
At the very end, there is no single answer. Only probabilities.
It picks a word, adds it to the sentence, and starts again.
Dark, quiet, and full of light.
It does not think in words. It thinks in shapes of meaning. And then, one word at a time, it speaks.
